tweets.text: Your legs are trashed after leg day. A $100 massage gun or $250+ compression boots -- which one actually gets you back on your feet faster? The answer depends on your budget more than you'd think.

Massage gun vs compression boots, quick breakdown: massage gun = $100-400, portable, targeted, 10-15 min sessions. Compression boots = $250-1000+, hands-free, full-leg, 20-30 min sessions. Blood clot history or pregnancy? Talk to a doctor first.

Before: dragging yourself up the stairs the morning after squats, calves screaming. After: 20 minutes in compression boots (or a quick massage gun session) and you're walking normal again. The right recovery tool makes that difference.

Massage gun or compression boots -- which one is actually worth your money? We compared price, recovery time, and real-life scenarios (plus who should skip both and see a doctor first). Full breakdown here: https://lionlion0201-jpg.github.io/home-recovery-blog/posts/massage-gun-vs-compression-boots-recovery/ #RecoveryGear #HomeWellness
